text:
ana: kicking off llm-router v2.7.1 deploy in the 01:00-03:00 UTC window. Primary change: new session-affinity logic behind flag `llmroute_affinity_v2`. Rollout plan: canary -> 3% (10m) -> 15% (20m) -> evaluate for 50% next window. Release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/release/llm-router-v2.7.1 :shipit:

deploy-bot: Automated: deploy started service=llm-router version=v2.7.1 by ana. Canary stage active. Manual approvals required for each ramp.

chris: holdpoint: keep 3% for full 10m. Gates: p95 delta < 150ms, sticky-session mismatch < 0.5% (fraction of requests routed to wrong model). If mismatch > 1% OR p95 > 400ms -> disable flag and pin back.

ana: note: manifest pins `route.model_pin = "v2.6-stable"` for cohorts not on flag; affinity path uses v2.7 model shard. We'll unpin after stable soak.

sre-oncall: infra watch enabled. Runbook rollback triggers: p95 > 500ms OR 5xx > 0.8% for 3m -> `/deploybot flag disable llmroute_affinity_v2` and pin to v2.6-stable. Also prefer soft-throttle at edge first if queue pressure without errors.

deploy-bot: Flag update: `llmroute_affinity_v2` -> 3% prod cohorts (internal QA override 100%) by ana.

chris: smoke (6m): sticky mismatch 0.12%, p95 +28ms, errors 0.05% — looks good. :thumbsup:

beth: seeing small uptick in cookie churn on edge (count +4%). Not an error but flagging.

sre-oncall: checked, no 5xx or resource saturation. Watching for cookie churn impact.

chris: scheduling ramp to 15% at +15m if gates hold. /approve when ready.

ana: /approve ramp to 15%.

deploy-bot: Action executed: `llmroute_affinity_v2` -> 15% by ana at 01:18 UTC.

beth: post-ramp (5m): sticky mismatch 0.3%, p95 = +45ms, edge cookie churn stabilized. Recommend hold 30m and add a short blurb to release notes about affinity fallback: falls back to round-robin when mismatch detected.

chris: adding to release notes: "Session-affinity v2 gradual rollout (3% -> 15%). Fallback: automatic revert to round-robin and pin to v2.6-stable on mismatch or latency breaches. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/llmroute-affinity"

ana: release notes updated and changelog pinned. Will open a follow-up thread for the next-window 50% decision. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
